senses.en: the part of the face below the mouth

example.en: He rested his chin on his hand.

senses.en: to pull yourself up until your chin is above a bar

example.en: She chinned herself on the bar.
example.zh: 她在单杠上做了引体向上。

senses.en: the function or position someone has in a situation or organization

example.en: She played a key role in the project.
example.zh: 她在这个项目中发挥了关键作用。

senses.en: a character played by an actor

example.en: He won an award for his role in the film.
example.zh: 他因在这部电影中的角色获奖。
